# Optional — Depth Anything V2 Small F16 (Core ML)

Build 27 primary depth path does **not** require this model.

To enable optional Core ML comparison on device:

1. Download `DepthAnythingV2SmallF16.mlpackage` from
   https://huggingface.co/apple/coreml-depth-anything-v2-small
2. Place under this directory and add to the Xcode app target (Copy Bundle Resources)
3. License: Apache-2.0 — see repo NOTICE

Do not commit large binaries unless explicitly approved.
